perk.skycraft.acrobatics.aerial_strike.d: Melee attacks made while falling do 25% more damage.
perk.skycraft.acrobatics.cat_fall.desc: Falls of up to ten blocks do no damage at all.
perk.skycraft.acrobatics.double_jump.des: Press jump again in mid-air to leap once more, for a little stamina.
perk.skycraft.acrobatics.featherfall.des: Take 25% less falling damage per rank.
perk.skycraft.acrobatics.tumble.desc: Land a fall while sneaking to roll out of it: half the damage, and short drops cost nothing.
perk.skycraft.cooking.camp_cook.desc: Meals you cook restore 25 points of Stamina.
perk.skycraft.cooking.cook.desc: Meals you cook are 10% more effective per rank.
perk.skycraft.cooking.gourmet.desc: Meals you cook also shield you with extra Health for two minutes.
perk.skycraft.cooking.hearty_meals.desc: Meals you cook restore 15 extra points of Health.
perk.skycraft.cooking.master_chef.desc: Meals you cook fortify Health for three minutes.
perk.skycraft.cooking.preserver.desc: Meals you cook cure hunger, poison and nausea.
perk.skycraft.cooking.seasoned.desc: 15% chance to cook an extra portion of each dish.
Cast Adept-level Mysticism spells for half magicka.
perk.skycraft.mysticism.anchor.desc: Mark, Recall and the Intervention spells cost half as much, and Recall returns you across worlds.
perk.skycraft.mysticism.apprentice_mysti: Cast Apprentice-level Mysticism spells for half magicka.
perk.skycraft.mysticism.dispeller.desc: Dispel also strips enemies around you of their magic and banishes their summons.
perk.skycraft.mysticism.dual_casting.des: Dual casting a Mysticism spell overcharges the effects into an even more powerful version (2.2x magnitude at 2.8x cost).
perk.skycraft.mysticism.expert_mysticism: Cast Expert-level Mysticism spells for half magicka.
perk.skycraft.mysticism.far_sight.desc: Telekinesis and Detect Life reach twice as far.
perk.skycraft.mysticism.featherweight.de: Levitate, Slowfall and Water Walking last 50% longer, and you levitate faster and higher.
perk.skycraft.mysticism.master_mysticism: Cast Master-level Mysticism spells for half magicka.
perk.skycraft.mysticism.mirror_mage.desc: Reflect Spell, Spell Absorption and Spell Turning are 15 points stronger.
perk.skycraft.mysticism.novice_mysticism: Cast Novice-level Mysticism spells for half magicka.
perk.skycraft.mysticism.spellbinder.desc: Spell Absorption also drinks dragon breath and staff magic.
perk.skycraft.mysticism.thaumaturge.desc: Absorb spells drain 25% more per rank.
perk.skycraft.polearm.impale.desc: Polearm attacks have a 10% chance per rank to make the target bleed.
perk.skycraft.polearm.lancer.desc: Polearms do 20% more damage per rank.
perk.skycraft.polearm.long_reach.desc: Strike half a block farther with a spear, halberd or glaive.
perk.skycraft.polearm.phalanx.desc: With a polearm in hand, melee blows from the front do 20% less damage.
perk.skycraft.polearm.pinning_strike.des: Spear thrusts pin the target in place for two seconds.
perk.skycraft.polearm.set_against_charge: Polearms do 50% more damage to enemies charging at you.
perk.skycraft.polearm.skewer.desc: Polearm attacks have a 15% chance to paralyze the target for two seconds.
perk.skycraft.polearm.sweeping_arc.desc: Halberd and glaive blows also cut up to two more enemies in front of you for half damage.
perk.skycraft.riding.bond.desc: Your horse slowly heals while you ride it.
perk.skycraft.riding.cavalry_charge.desc: Blows struck at a gallop do 50% more damage and stagger the target.
perk.skycraft.riding.horse_archer.desc: Arrows shot from the saddle do 25% more damage.
perk.skycraft.riding.horseman.desc: Your horse runs 5% faster per rank.
perk.skycraft.riding.mounted_combat.desc: Melee attacks from the saddle do 25% more damage.
perk.skycraft.riding.stable_hand.desc: Your horse takes 25% less damage while you ride it.
perk.skycraft.riding.trample.desc: A galloping horse knocks down and hurts small creatures in its way.
